info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Security Assurance Review-spec
info.description: The Security Assurance Review Submission API facilitates the submission of security assurance reviews for enterprise banking services. This endpoint allows authorized users to initiate a new review, contributing to the overall management and enhancement of security practices. Typical consumers of this API include security analysts and compliance officers tasked with ensuring adherence to security standards within the banking domain. By streamlining the review process, organizations can identify potential vulnerabilities and address them in a timely manner.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new security assurance review for the specified resource RES-100045. Ensure all required information is provided to successfully create the review.
